description: Returns a paginated list of project-level project status snapshots with optional filtering and sorting

parameters.name: filters[status_id]
parameters.description: Filter snapshots by PSS custom status ID

parameters.name: filters[financial_period_id][]
parameters.description: Filter snapshots by financial period ID. Accepts one or more IDs. Pass the token `null` (or `nil`) as a value to match snapshots that have no financial period. Tokens and IDs can be combined — e.g....

parameters.name: comparison_budget_column_ids
parameters.description: Restrict comparison data to these budget column IDs. When omitted, comparison is returned for all columns.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order for the returned snapshots. Prefix a value with `-` for descending order. `created_at` sorts by when the snapshot was taken; `financial_period` sorts by the associated financial period's...

created_at.description: The time the snapshot request was created

currency_configuration.description: Currency configuration object, the currency for the snapshot

financial_period.description: The financial period associated with this snapshot. Null when the snapshot was not created within a financial period.
